text: The 0.42 kV system voltage is the no-load secondary voltage of the 10.5/0.42 kV transformers (DEC-EPCE-0016). LV motors are rated 400 V (Zone A, +/- 5 % per IEC 60034-1) so that the 420 V no-load voltage does not exceed the motor and equipment rating; the requirement ER-11.04 designation '0.4 kV' is met by this system.
